2608.16514.title: Matched Outcomes, Divergent Gaze: How Foveated MLLMs Search Compared to Humans
2608.16514.paper_summary: Human visual search is serial: the fovea must land on a candidate to confirm it, and those landings form a scanpath. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs), given the same foveated input, search as humans do bears on their use as models of human vision and on attention-alignment scores. We compare three general-purpose MLLMs with human eye-movement scanpaths on goal-directed search (COCO-Search18), driving each model fixation by fixation through an identical, human-matched foveated view and assessing it along three axes: the decision of target presence, the efficiency of reaching the target, and the gaze process itself. The axes dissociate. On the decision and on target acquisition the models match or exceed humans, detecting present targets near ceiling and reaching them on the first saccade more often than people do. The gaze process is not human. Under the human-matched condition, all three share one signature: low-entropy, large-amplitude, self-consistent scanpaths that agree with themselves far more closely than two humans agree with each other. That is consistent with a single-pass, non-serial architecture rather than a limit of acuity. Matched retinal input reproduces where humans look but not how the looking unfolds in time, and no degradation regime recovers human-like search at human-like success. The gap sits on a process axis that answer-alignment and saliency metrics do not measure. Because they miss it, such metrics cannot certify human-like vision, and zero-shot models suit outcome and spatial questions but not temporal, process-level ones.
2608.16514.paper_summary_zh: 人類的視覺搜尋是串行的：中央凹必須落在候選物上以確認它，而這些落點形成了一條掃描路徑。多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在給定相同的中央凹輸入時，是否以人類的方式進行搜尋，對於它們作為人類視覺模型的使用以及注意力對齊分數有重要影響。我們比較了三個通用的MLLMs與人類在目標導向搜尋（COCO-Search18）中的眼動掃描路徑，逐一引導每個模型的注視，通過相同的、與人類匹配的中央凹視圖進行評估，並沿著三個軸進行評估：目標存在的決策、達到目標的效率以及注視過程本身。這些軸是獨立的。在目標存在的決策和目標獲取上，這些模型與人類相匹配或超越，檢測到的存在目標接近上限，並且比人類更常在第一次眼跳中達到它們。注視過程則不是人類的。在與人類匹配的條件下，這三個模型共享一個特徵：低熵、大幅度、自我一致的掃描路徑，這些掃描路徑與自身的協調程度遠高於兩個人類之間的協調程度。這與單次通過的非串行架構一致，而不是敏銳度的限制。匹配的視網膜輸入重現了人類的注視位置，但並未重現注視隨時間展開的方式，且沒有任何退化機制能夠恢復人類般的搜尋和成功率。這一差距位於一個過程軸上，而答案對齊和顯著性度量並未測量到。因為它們忽略了這一點，因此這些度量無法證明人類般的視覺，而零-shot模型適合結果和空間問題，但不適合時間、過程層級的問題。
